test_title: SSC CPO Tier-II Previous Year Paper (Held On: 8th November 2021)
subject: general
question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate option to substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence. If there is no need to substitute it, select ‘No substitution required’.**

__Play being recognized__ as an important factor in improving the mental and physical health of children.
solution: The correct answer is **'Play is recognized.'** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • Here, we need to use a passive voice. • The passive voice is used to show interest in the person or object that experiences an action rather than the person or object that performs the action. • **"Is being"** is used to describe an action that started in the past and continues at present. • The phrase 'Play being recognized' can be changed to passive voice by modifying it to** 'Play is recognized.'** • Hence, that part should be replaced with 'Play is recognised.' • Thus, the correct answer is 'Play is recognized.' • ​The correct sentence__: ***Play is recognized **as an important factor in improving the mental and physical health of children.* ​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** __ • The meaning of the word 'recognize' is to know someone or something because you have seen or heard him or her or experienced it before. • Example:* I hadn't seen her for 20 years, but I **recognized** her immediately.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **Hinglish__** • यहां, हमें एक passive voice का उपयोग करने की आवश्यकता है। • Passive voice का उपयोग उस व्यक्ति या object में रुचि दिखाने के लिए किया जाता है जो उस व्यक्ति या वस्तु के बजाय एक क्रिया का अनुभव करता है जो क्रिया करता है। • "Is being" का उपयोग एक ऐसी क्रिया का वर्णन करने के लिए किया जाता है जो अतीत में शुरू हुई और वर्तमान में जारी है। • वाक्यांश 'Play being recognized' को 'Play is recognized' में संशोधित करके passive voice में बदला जा सकता है। • इस भाग को 'Play is recognized' से बदल दिया जाना चाहिए। ec:T143a, The correct answer is '​orthopaedist.'
